text: The user asked for the yolo-twice scaffold, so the assistant built a working skeleton in parallel tracks instead of empty folders: core ingest, redaction and store, analyzers, an engine daemon and CLI on port 9656, a Claude Code plugin, a React UI, a VitePress site, a Slidev deck and a GitHub Pages workflow. Core and analyzers were committed as a988456 with 16 passing tests, the engine has 20 passing tests, the UI build and a Playwright smoke run succeeded, and `/yolo-twice:yolo-twice status` ran through the installed plugin. The rest is unfinished: the other tracks are uncommitted, Slidev 53 needs Bun because it fails on Node 20.12, and Pages was not enabled because the user has write but not admin rights on bar9/yolo-twice.
